description: The comments under a mention's post, newest first: the whole thread, whether or not each comment names the keyword, each with its author, text, time, engagement, a light sentiment and intent read, and mentionId when the comment is itself one of your mentions. Filled from 30 minutes after the post and read again while its platform's conversations last (a day on Reddit, Hacker News and Bluesky, a week on GitHub, Stack Overflow and DEV, a month on YouTube) for relevant mentions whose keyword has comments enabled (add_keyword / update_keyword `comments`); empty otherwise. Page with cursor.
name: list_mention_comments
title: List mention comments
